test_title: PYST 51: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Shifa can do a certain piece of work in 20 days. Shifa and Afiya can together do the same work in 12 days, and Shifa, Afiya and Mariyam can do the same work together in 9 days. In how many days can Shifa and Mariyam do the same work together?
solution:
**Given:**

Shifa alone can do the work in 20 days

Shifa and Afiya together can do the work in 12 days

Shifa, Afiya and Mariyam together can do the work in 9 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = Rate × Time

Combined rate = Sum of individual rates

Time = 1 ÷ Rate

**Calculation:**

⇒ Shifa’s rate = 1 ÷ 20

⇒ (Shifa + Afiya)’s rate = 1 ÷ 12

⇒ (Shifa + Afiya + Mariyam)&rsq
